localEnvironment.semanticsBoundary: Local imported module resolves installed HEAD to candidate; installed/candidate/base exception registry blobs and module blobs were checked identical. Git root is a Windows D bare metadata store with C object alternates, not the hosted Linux checkout.

staticFindings.finding: recognizeExceptionExecution constructs campaign plus installed, candidate and base registry rows without deduplication. With the three identical 26-row registries this is 79 records, subject to records.some short circuit.

For qualifying denial signals and exact protected-base comparison, each visited record can call direct campaignRelated. The callback also checks ancestry once per visited record before its return expression.
campaignRelated uses the direct source adapter. A separate campaignComparison owns memoized revision inventories, document reads, identities and ancestor results, but recognition does not call it.
Direct campaign comparison can repeat candidate recursive inventories, contract reads, source identity checks, ancestry, and immutable-history presence lookups across visited records.
Replay admission precedes diagnostic profile setup and onDiagnosticScope; missing runtime/profile paths is consistent with a pre-scope halt but does not by itself prove the exact hosted substage.

probe.cleanupBoundary: Creation-bound Windows Job Object reported tree reaped and streams closed. No separate host process-table audit was performed.

conclusion: The single 10-second local recognizer did not finish and demonstrated repeated completed Git reads through its final second. This supports a measurable repeated-read fanout hypothesis; it does not prove the cause of the hosted 20-minute stall, deadlock, completion time, or entitlement to another capture.
